name: Altstadthotel Weisses Kreuz
beschreibung: The Altstadthotel Weisses Kreuz is located in the historic old town of Innsbruck. Nearby attractions are the Goldene Dachl and the Hofburg. The rooms have private bathrooms and free Wi-Fi access. The 16th-century building combines historic architecture with modern amenities. A breakfast buffet is served daily. Guests can expect an uncomplicated atmosphere with direct access to the pedestrian zone.
